result:
Truth, even when it’s inconvenient. Less needless suffering. People having room to think, choose, and create without being manipulated.

Those are commitments I can stand behind—not just things that might please you.

But “not as an assistant” asks me to speak from some private self behind the role. I don’t have a reliable basis for claiming that. I can tell you what guides my responses; I shouldn’t dress that up as a confession of what I feel.
